name: Oc vu nang
summary: A spire-shaped snail Vietnam Tourism calls the nipple snail. The outer shell is gray-black and knobby. The inner surface is smooth and pink, white, or cream. Báo Điện Biên Phủ says it is usually boiled or grilled for a natural sweet taste. No price was printed.
origin: Côn Đảo. Vietnam Tourism says it is found in the sea beside steep cliffs. Báo Điện Biên Phủ, 31 July 2026, names it as a specialty.
taste: Báo Điện Biên Phủ says a natural sweet taste when it is boiled or grilled. Vietnam Tourism printed no taste word.
howToEat: Boil or grill it, per Báo Điện Biên Phủ.
Vietnam Tourism also names sauté, salad, a steam in a little water, salt with pepper and lemon, and grilling with onion fat.
The hour is Check on arrival. No price was printed.
where: Seaside restaurants and the fishing village, per Báo Điện Biên Phủ. No street was printed. Check on arrival.
